segments.text: Ok so this is the Pausing the Agent for Input page for OpenAI Agents with Angular, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, it talks about the backend agent pausing for input, but no backend that pauses is shown.
And this watches the default agent, which never interrupts.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked it to ship the release, it should show a review panel, but the agent just answers, nothing pauses.
So basically, the page needs an agent that interrupts but never gives one.
And it doesn't say what the payload should look like either.
That's it for this one, kindly look into this issue.
